method: Use project-author and collaborator profiles to identify each project, then primary organizer pages for event dates. Event dates describe the designathon milestone, not a later redesign or case-study publication. Do not use dates inside sample UI, copyright notices, asset exports, or CMS imports as project dates.

findings.title: Garden

sources.evidence: Garden is listed under November 2024 and the SunLife UXperience Design Jam.
Garden is dated November 2024 and explicitly identifies Winston Zhao as an interface-design collaborator at the SunLife event.
The Sun Life uXperience Design Jam took place November 2, 2024. The article was published November 8, which is a separate date.
Garden cover. Nearby gallery text labels the project uXperience Design Jam.

uncertainties: No independent record of subsequent design revision dates was found.
November 2 is the mapped event date, rather than a directly stated file-creation date.

findings.title: HabitAt
findings.dateBasis: Matching project-author and team-member project dates
findings.confidence: high for year and month; day unknown
findings.projectContext: First Place, UW/UX and GBDA Society Design Sprint 2025

sources.evidence: HabitAt and its UWUX Design Sprint first-place award are dated June 2025.
HabitAt is also dated June 2025 and identified as First Place at the UWUX Design Sprint 2025.
Reposted GBDA Society results name HabitAt as the first-place team, with Winston Zhao, Amna Sahi, Andrew Chu, and Anita Du. The text describes a Monday-night event without an exact calendar date.
UW/UX places its collaboration with GBDA Society in Spring 2025. It does not supply an exact date.
HabitAt cover, with no embedded project date.

uncertainties: No exact day was located. Keep the display precision at June 2025.

A runner-up participant, Cathy Yin, lists Snap Habit and the same sprint under July 2025. The matching June entries from Winston and teammate Amna take precedence for HabitAt; the discrepancy remains documented rather than silently resolved.

findings.title: MuniSync / YRConnect
findings.dateBasis: Project submission/update date at mapped hackathon

sources.evidence: YRConnect names Winston as creator, links to YRHacks 2024 and its Second Place award, and records the project update on April 18, 2024 at 5:35 PM EDT.
The hacking period starts April 17, 2024, continues in person April 18, and closes April 18.
Submissions open April 17 at 6 PM and close April 18 at 5:30 PM EDT; winners are announced April 18.
YRConnect is listed under April 2024 and identifies YRHacks 2024.
The MuniSync page contains YRConnect onboarding and the matching municipal-app screens.

uncertainties: The Devpost timestamp dates the submitted project entry; actual design work spans the April 17–18 event.
Dates displayed within sample bookings and event cards do not date the project.
